project.title: Task Board API + Client
project.spec: Build a small task-tracking app: a REST API backed by a database, and a frontend that consumes it. Users can create boards, add tasks, and mark them done without a full page reload.
criteria: Implements token-based authentication with at least one protected route
Exposes a documented REST API for creating, reading, updating, and deleting tasks
Frontend updates task state optimistically, without a full page reload

criteria_scores.criterion: Implements token-based authentication with at least one protected route
criteria_scores.note: JWT issued on login and verified via middleware on /tasks routes.

criteria_scores.criterion: Exposes a documented REST API for creating, reading, updating, and deleting tasks
criteria_scores.note: Clean REST surface — GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/tasks, documented in the README.

criteria_scores.criterion: Frontend updates task state optimistically, without a full page reload
criteria_scores.note: Task list re-renders from local state immediately; the API call happens in the background.

submissions.feedback: Solid, idiomatic implementation — the optimistic update path in particular is well done.

project.title: Customer Churn Classifier
project.spec: Train a classifier that predicts customer churn from a tabular dataset, and serve it behind a minimal prediction endpoint.
criteria: Trains a supervised model on a labeled dataset with a documented train/test split
Reports precision, recall, and F1 rather than accuracy alone
Exposes the trained model behind a prediction endpoint

criteria_scores.criterion: Trains a supervised model on a labeled dataset with a documented train/test split
criteria_scores.note: scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier with an 80/20 stratified split — clean and reproducible.

criteria_scores.criterion: Reports precision, recall, and F1 rather than accuracy alone
criteria_scores.note: F1 is computed but never printed or logged anywhere; precision/recall are absent.

criteria_scores.criterion: Exposes the trained model behind a prediction endpoint
criteria_scores.note: No serving code found — the model is trained and pickled, but nothing exposes it over HTTP.

submissions.feedback: The modeling half is strong. Add a small prediction endpoint (even a single Flask/FastAPI route) to close the loop from training to serving.
